description: A utility class for vector similarity/distance function implementations, including methods for cosine similarity, inner product, and Euclidean distance, optimized with manual loop unrolling for SIMD.

classes.name: VectorFunctionImplUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing vector similarity and distance functions with SIMD optimization.

methods.name: vectorCosineSimilarity
methods.description: Calculates cosine similarity between two float vectors, returns null if invalid or zero magnitude.

methods.name: vectorInnerProduct
methods.description: Calculates inner (dot) product between two float vectors, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: vectorL2Distance
methods.description: Calculates Euclidean distance between two float vectors, returns null if invalid.
